# Pact Raven

Pact Raven is a commitment and accountability product for users in India. Users create a pact, lock money behind it, show proof, and receive refund credit when proof is approved. Missed or rejected days forfeit to the user's chosen charity, not Pact Raven revenue.

## Core model

- Lock money. Show proof daily. Missed days go to charity.
- Pact Raven starts with workout pacts and content pacts.
- Every account gets the first Pact Pass covered once. After that, each Pact Pass is Rs 249.
- A Pact Pass unlocks one pact record. The separate pact deposit is refundable only through approved proof and manual settlement rules.
- Workout proof requires fresh in-app camera capture, captured device location, and the daily physical prompt.
- Content proof requires a public post link that matches the pact rules.
- Approved proof creates refund credit for manual UPI payout.
- Missed, late, unclear, private, deleted, or rejected proof may forfeit the related deposit credit to the selected charity.
- Pact Raven is currently a paid beta for India-based users who are at least 18 years old.
- Approved refund credit is available for manual UPI payout after approval. Users may submit up to two manual withdrawal requests per week.
- Current charity choices are user-selected destinations, not formal Pact Raven charity partners unless stated otherwise. Forfeited amounts are transferred in monthly batches.
